# Channel Selection & Testing

`channel-selection-and-testing` · v1.0.0 · Design · Paid Media & Budgeting
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/channel-selection-and-testing/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** How much should we spend, and for how long, before judging a new channel; when should we stop early; and which channel should we test first?

**Inputs:** Target cost per customer, weekly budget, and for each candidate channel its cost per click (or CPM and CTR), the share of clicks that become a lead, and the share of leads that become customers; optionally a total test budget, sales cycle, time limit, and the spend and leads so far

**Output:** Per channel - expected cost per lead and per customer on the user's own numbers, the leads, spend and weeks a fair read needs, what a customer-level read would take, a stop table and a verdict; across channels - which to test first; with progress - stop, ahead, read complete or keep going

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill channel-selection-and-testing`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/channel-selection-and-testing/resources/channel-test.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/channel-selection-and-testing/resources/channel-test.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It is only as good as the rates you give it. Cost per click, click-to-lead and lead-to-customer rates are your inputs; guesses there carry straight into the plan, so label them and re-run once the first week's numbers are in.
- The read is on leads, not customers, because customers arrive too slowly to judge a test on. A good cost per lead still has to be followed to customers over one full sales cycle before you scale.
- The lead count uses a normal approximation; the stop table and progress checks use exact Poisson math. Both assume leads arrive at a steady rate, which a campaign change, a holiday or a viral post breaks.
- The ±30% precision, 90% confidence, two-week minimum, twelve-week maximum and the 10% near-tie rule are AAJ's defaults, not industry benchmarks. Change them to fit the decision.

**Review before acting:** Whoever owns the channel confirms the rates are measured or clearly labelled as estimates, that the lead event will not change during the test, and that the stop table is written into the plan before the first dollar is spent.
